headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to carry out a 2026 law placing sanctions related to Russia and Iran.
what_it_does: This order sets up how the executive branch will put into effect the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, a law dealing with sanctions on Russia and Iran. No summary was provided, so the specific sanctions, targets, and agency duties in the order are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to carry out the sanctions required by the 2026 law, though the specific duties are not described in the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Individuals, companies, and governments connected to Russia or Iran
who_it_affects.how: They may face sanctions under the law this order implements, but the specific targets are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the available information; the order was signed October 16, 2026.
